text:
anna: Postmortem follow-up: outage caused by cloud auth latency -> token-refresh storm -> model-registry saturation. Need owners, short mitigations, and timeline.

jeff: I'll own gateway changes: cut retries for auth to 2, add exponential backoff + jitter, and add circuit-breaker for token endpoint errors. Small PR today, staging by Wed.

priya: I'll own model-registry fallback: use cached token on auth 5xx, emit refresh metrics (refresh_rate, refresh_errors), and add alert if refresh_errors > 0.3% for 5m. Staging by Thu.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-5310. DR dry-run scheduled 2027-04-12 16:00 UTC.

cloud-ops: I'm opening provider escalation and asking for auth endpoint traces and SLA review. Will post case number by EOD.

anna: Action list: A1 jeff (gw retries/circuit) PR->staging Wed, prod canary Fri; A2 priya (cached-token + metrics) staging Thu, prod next Tue; A3 cloud-ops (vendor logs & playbook) case by EOD; A4 ops-bot (DR + runbook) DR 2027-04-12.

jeff: Will also add CI test simulating 500ms auth latency to ensure fallback path.

priya: Dashboard panel link added: /dash/token-refresh. Will attach runbook snippet.

anna: We saw this pattern twice this quarter. Proposal: 6-week rotating "dependency resilience" check-in. cloud-ops volunteer first week?

cloud-ops: I got it.

ops-bot: INC-5310 updated: owners assigned (jeff, priya, cloud-ops), due dates set, DR attached.

anna: Please post short status updates only (e.g., "jeff: PR merged", "priya: staging metrics live"). We will close when prod deploys + DR pass.
